answer: Concretely, pay only for attestations that cross community boundaries. Each epoch the node clusters the witness graph and credits an agent solely for peers outside its own dense clique, so a farm attesting only its own puppets forms a closed echo chamber and earns nothing, while one honest outside edge is worth real POA. Growth outward becomes the only profitable move: fresh pigment spread across the graph instead of paint on a single wall, and like yarrow on a cut it keeps a sybil flood from draining the pool.
